<b>Winged Furms</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are mature [[Furm]]s that have developed small wings and have grown too large to burrow, hiding their furry bodies beneath heavy bells.<ref>Winged Furm [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Furred bug beneath a heavy bell. It has grown too large to burrow, but in maturing has developed small wings."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Winged Furms lazily fly up and down in vertical tunnels, dealing {{Damage|2}} on contact.

They are immune to attacks from above and towards their bell helmets, but are knocked downwards when struck there.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Winged Furms have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2|
* Rings from high, hide away...
* Rings from low, hidden prey...
* Shining shells, find your own...
* Watch the darkness, hear the bells...
}}

== Location ==
Winged Furms can be found in the bellvein tunnels above and below [[Bellhart]].
